name: Portable Hotspot of Emergency Bandwidth
flavor_text: A blinking plastic brick that has saved more relationships than therapy.
rules_text: Spend 1 charge to ignore Power Loss or poor WiFi penalties for 1 scene. Spend 2 charges to grant the same benefit to the whole party in one zone.

name: Power Bank of Infinite Charge
flavor_text: A power bank with sticker residue, emotional damage, and impossible endurance.
rules_text: You are immune to Power Loss while carrying this item. Spend 1 charge to remove Power Loss from an ally or recharge one tech-based item mid-scene.

name: Passport Wallet of Plausible Innocence
flavor_text: It smells faintly of immigration lines and half-truths.
rules_text: Once per long rest you may reroll a failed visa, customs, or bureaucracy check and reduce Heat by 1 if the reroll succeeds.
